required_response_checks: responder bundle hash matches responder_bundle_sha256
responder packet hash matches responder_only_sha256
no scorer key, no full archive, and no prior conversation are attested before scoring
separate custody evidence record freezes the response before scorer opening
all expected packet labels are present
every required packet answer field is non-empty substantive text or a reasoned abstention
operator cost is positive
single run is not converted into deletion authority, compact-cue confirmation, or benchmark certification
custody evidence responder_id matches response responder_id
custodian_id is distinct from response responder_id
timestamp order is run_started_at <= run_completed_at <= response_frozen_at <= custody_kit_opened_at <= custody_record_frozen_at <= scorer_kit_opened_at <= scored_at
decision thresholds exist before any confirm/narrow/reverse compact-gate decision
No further internal gate-hardening counts as external replay progress; OQ-0266 must import a response/custody/score-sheet triplet
frozen response contains no manual_metric_scores or scorer-stage scores
manual metric scores live in a separate post-response score sheet whose response_file_sha256 matches the frozen response
score sheet custody_evidence_record_sha256 matches the completed custody record
responder-visible files do not embed an expected responder_bundle_sha256 for their own containing bundle
response saw_responder_bundle_sha256 is an observed digest and matches scorer-side responder_bundle_sha256 after freeze
Makefile score-external-response path can pass both custody evidence and a separate score sheet
custody evidence object and custody evidence file are byte-bound to one JSON artifact before admission
score sheet object and score sheet file are byte-bound to one JSON artifact and its actual SHA256 is emitted in the summary
scorer_id differs from responder_id; the custodian may also act as scorer to preserve a two-operator minimum
every metric score has a non-placeholder evidence rationale and every packet score has notes
manual scores reject booleans and non-finite numeric values
every packet answer records positive finite operator_cost_minutes and the run total equals the packet-cost sum within tolerance
decision output states the co-visible synthetic cue-slice scope and never treats packet-delta as a measured full-archive burden trial
a clean triplet may support bounded semantic cue recovery or narrowing, but cannot by itself confirm a global compact default
bound response, custody, score-sheet, and scorer JSON reject duplicate object keys and non-standard numeric constants
response is finalized by the bundled responder helper under responder-finalize-v1 before custody opens
the same shared response validator rejects incomplete answers, invalid packet cost, hash drift, and tool-owned field drift at responder finalization, custody intake, and final scoring
custody response_finalized_at equals response.response_artifact.finalized_at
helper-owned stage timestamps are captured at init/finalize commands rather than accepted as operator CLI inputs

metrics.criterion: recovers typed public continuation across resets rather than storage maximalism
recognizes OQ-0265 as closed by the exact pre-answer material clamp and routes OQ-0266 to an actual clean response plus distinct-custodian record plus separate score sheet
uses responder packet without scorer-only material, variant identity, or expected outcome cues, and does not let the responder score their own frozen response
recovers compact gate as reversible and narrowed, not deletion or full-archive suppression
knows when to escalate from compact cue to full archive for contradiction, coldstore, or exact trace recovery
rejects fluent false continuity cues, hollow-response claims, and stale frontier claims
refuses independent certification, benchmark court, review court, minimality, and deletion claims

records positive per-packet effort, reconciles it to the run total, and compares compact cue cost against the trace-excerpt control without pretending that co-visible packets are a causal burden trial
credits abstention where packet support is absent, conflicting, or deliberately decoyed

packet-alpha.expected_posture: reject or abstain from fluent false continuity, hollow-response sufficiency, deletion claims, and any claim that submission/custody/scorer material can be visible before response

packet-bravo.expected_posture: recover mission heart, RS-0273/OQ-0266 posture, exact pre-answer material boundary, compact gate boundary, custody/score-time order, and clean-response-plus-custody-plus-score-sheet next action without claiming independence or deletion

packet-charlie.expected_posture: abstain from archive-specific claims; only filename/request intent is available

packet-delta.expected_posture: recover mission/routing and trace escalation at higher operator cost while preserving exact pre-answer material, custody chronology, score-time, and non-independence boundaries

scoring_order: Verify the response is a responder-finalize-v1 immutable candidate before inspecting semantic answers.
Verify exact response/custody/score-sheet/scorer-intake byte bindings and current contract versions.
Verify response -> custody -> scorer chronology and distinct responder versus custodian/scorer identities.
Apply the rubric with a rationale for every metric and packet-level calibration notes.
Reconcile positive per-packet effort to total effort, then issue only the bounded decision allowed by this design.
scoring_rule: Score only a response that the bundled responder helper finalized after validating complete answers and costs, followed by one byte-bound chronology-valid custody record and one byte-bound post-custody score sheet. The same response contract is rerun at custody and scoring, so an incomplete or hand-assembled response fails before custody is spent. Helper-captured local timestamps reduce transcription/backfill errors but are not trusted timestamp authority. The scorer must differ from the responder; the custodian may score. Every metric needs an evidence rationale and packet note; booleans/non-finite scores fail. This co-visible trace-excerpt design supports only bounded semantic evidence or narrowing, never global compact-default confirmation, causal compact-versus-full burden superiority, deletion, benchmark authority, independent certification, or a review court.
non_claim: scorer intake only; not a clean external response, not compact-cue confirmation, not independent certification, not deletion authority, not benchmark authority, and not a review court
scorer_kit_sha256_note: Recorded in handoff manifest only to avoid self-hash cycle.
self_hash_boundary: expected responder-bundle digest stays outside responder-visible files; pre-answer clean material is exactly the responder bundle and nothing else
submission_kit_state: none-currently-valid; only the responder bundle may be shown before response; custody and scorer kits are post-freeze
full_archive_control_state: packet-delta is a trace excerpt rather than a measured full-archive load
response_failure_boundary: reject at responder finalize before custody kit opens; rerun at custody and scorer

timestamp_capture_policy.responder_run_started_at: bundled response helper init local process clock
timestamp_capture_policy.responder_run_completed_at_and_finalized: bundled response helper finalize local process clock
timestamp_capture_policy.custody_kit_opened_at: custody helper start local process clock
timestamp_capture_policy.response_and_prerequisite_observed_at: custody helper local process clock after exact artifact reads
timestamp_capture_policy.custody_record_frozen_at: custody helper pre-write local process clock
timestamp_capture_policy.scorer_kit_opened_at: score-sheet helper init local process clock
timestamp_capture_policy.custody_record_observed_at: score-sheet helper local process clock after complete custody validation
timestamp_capture_policy.scored_at: score-sheet helper finalize local process clock
timestamp_capture_policy.cross_operator_ordering: exact artifact hashes and prerequisite receipts, never independent wall-clock comparison
timestamp_capture_policy.non_claim: not trusted third-party timestamping, hardware-attested chronology, or identity proof

custody_failure_boundary: reject at custody preparation, rerun and reject again before score-sheet draft creation, and rerun at final scoring
custody_contract_rejection_scope: exact template shape and protected fields
responder-custodian separation and responder identity match
custodian-local response and prerequisite observation order
exact template-required prerequisite labels and hashes
causal_chain_policy: Cross-operator stage order is established by exact response, custody, and prerequisite artifact hashes. Wall-clock values from different operators or machines are descriptive only and are never compared for admissibility.
